transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with today's material-review-board meeting. We have the lot of 1,000 precision valve housings that has completed molding and routine visual inspection, produced across four identified mold cavities. Before I record a disposition and release plan, I need to hear from each of you. Quality Systems, Process Engineering, and Logistics — please go ahead and report your findings on this lot.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important. During my audit of the customer's current portal requirements yesterday, I found that this lot of 1,000 valve housings requires CT scanning of exactly the first 120 housings before release, rather than our site's ordinary dimensional sample. I completed the portal review but have not yet entered this requirement into our internal inspection plan, so it would not currently appear in our standard inspection documentation.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report my cavity-level review findings. I found that exactly 180 housings from cavity 4 require rework for an undersized gate feature, while the other 820 housings are acceptable. I completed this review after checking the production records but have not yet uploaded the cavity review to the lot traveler.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I confirmed with the customer by phone this morning that exactly 820 acceptable housings can ship on Thursday and the 180 reworked housings can ship on Friday as a split shipment. I received that approval but have not yet logged it in the shipping system.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Ravi to enter the CT scanning requirement for the first 120 housings into the internal inspection plan before release
Marta to upload the cavity review findings to the lot traveler
Jon to log the customer-approved split shipment plan in the shipping system
